definitions.explanation: Made with special care, ingredients, or methods that distinguish it from the standard version. Often used in food and product marketing to indicate a premium or superior version.

examples.japanese: {特製|とくせい}⟦ソース→ソース：17673_soosu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: To pour on the special sauce.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{特製|とくせい}⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ほど⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: This shop's special ramen is so popular that people line up for it.

examples.japanese: ⟦シェフ→シェフ：05062_shefu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ふるって⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧{特製|とくせい}⟦デザート→デザート：00036_dezaato⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧きた。
examples.english: At the end, a specially made dessert that the chef had put all their skill into was brought out.

notes:
USAGE:
Very common on restaurant menus and in food marketing. A {特製|とくせい} item is typically the premium or signature version of a standard item, often with extra toppings, higher-quality ingredients, or special preparation. Also used outside food contexts for custom-made or specially crafted goods.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {特製|とくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: specially made ~
- {特製|とくせい} + noun (no ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧): also common, especially in compound names

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {特製|とくせい}⟦ソース→ソース：17673_soosu⟧: special sauce
- {特製|とくせい}⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧: special/deluxe ramen
- {特製|とくせい}⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧: special curry
- {特製|とくせい}⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧: special bento box
